Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 35 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An copycat wanting 116 effective identities must lock that capital for 35 epochs and keep it locked through every ivory audit. That is 26 dollars per alias.
